summary: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K regarding a firm-commitment public underwritten offering of units consisting of common stock (or pre-funded warrants) and warrants, with full exercise of the over-allotment option. The offering was conducted under an effective S-1 shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Terms include a unit price of $1.35, 7.5% underwriting fee, and typical underwriter warrants. No special-situation mechanics are present; the filing reports a standard equity issuance.
